name: The Ocean Club, Costa Norte
insider_take: This beachfront sanctuary sits on Costa Dorada's golden shores, where colonial charm meets Caribbean luxury in Puerto Plata's most coveted location.
whats_special: The Ocean Club occupies prime real estate on Playa Costa Dorada, one of the Dominican Republic's most pristine beaches. As a Luxury Collection property under Marriott STARS, guests enjoy exclusive perks like room upgrades and resort credits. The hotel's architecture pays homage to Puerto Plata's rich colonial heritage while offering modern oceanfront sophistication.
pro_tip: Book through our Marriott STARS program for automatic room upgrades, daily breakfast, and $100 resort credit - benefits you won't get booking direct.
dont_miss: Take the historic cable car up Mount Isabel de Torres for panoramic views, explore the 16th-century Fortaleza San Felipe just minutes away, or venture into Puerto Plata's charming colonial center with its Victorian-era architecture and vibrant local markets.
pros: Exclusive beachfront location with pristine Atlantic Ocean access
Luxury Collection standards with premium amenities and services
Marriott STARS Program benefits including room upgrades and resort credits
Strategic Puerto Plata location near cultural attractions and airport
cons: Adults-only environment may not suit families with children
Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
